도로로! (도로도로도로! )
​해석: "잡아! 집어!" (물건을 얼른 집으라는 뜻)

두쇼 코아이라! (두소 코이라! )
​해석: "200(타카) 씩!" (가격이 200타카라는 뜻)

하이레~" (하이레~)
​해석: "어머나 세상에~ / 맙소사"
​의미: 가격이 말도 안 되게 싸다는 걸 강조하는 추임새입니다. "이 가격 실화냐?" 같은 느낌입니다.

"바차롱, 도카롱" (Baicha lon, Deikha lon)
​해석: "골라 가세요, 보고 가세요" (영상 중간중간 섞여 들리는 뉘앙스)

en-US.title: December 21, 2025
en-US.description:
Although these are shouted with rhythm and mood rather than precise diction, the main lines are as follows:

Dororo! (Dororo, dororo!)
Interpretation: "Grab it! Pick it up!" (Meaning, grab the item quickly.)

Dusho Koaira! (Duso Koira!)
Interpretation: "Two hundred (taka) each!" (Meaning the price is 200 taka)

Note: In Bengali, 200 is "Duso," and "~sik/hayo" is "Koira."

"Hair~" (Hair~)
Interpretation: "Oh my goodness~ / Oh my goodness"
Meaning: An exclamation point that emphasizes the ridiculously low price. It's like saying, "Is this price real?"

"Bachalong, dokalong" (Baicha lon, Deikha lon)
Interpretation: "Choose yours, take a look" (a nuance heard intermittently throughout the video)
